item.title: A Graceful Manner And A Rock Star Glamour: Christine Baranski On The Great Tom Stoppard
item.description: “He wore the mantle of his fame lightly, rather like a cashmere scarf tossed around his neck,” recalls Baranski, who won a Tony for her role as Charlotte in Tom Stoppard’s “The Real Thing.” “We will not see the likes of him again.”
